observations.behavior: The prompt template for the summarizer LLM is simplified. The instruction to explicitly start a chapter at each long idle break is removed, and a minimum chapter duration of ~20 seconds is added. The hunk also removes the `long_idle_breaks` variable and its associated idle-break-specific instructions.

observations.behavior: Adds inactive_periods to SummarizerOutput and resolves chapters with inactive periods.

observations.behavior: Adds video_end_s_to_session_ms and cuts_video_s to VideoClock, supporting session-clock alignment at cuts and inactive stretches.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision backend gains session-clock-aware end-time and cut detection, enabling correct chapter boundaries when video jumps or user goes idle.

observations.behavior: Documentation change: removed the phrase 'taken from the render rather than the model' and added a parenthetical note about skipping idle chapters.
observations.code_quote: - `summarizer` → a `title`, a free-text `summary`, `chapters` (the active parts of the recording in order, each with `start_ms`, `end_ms`, a short `title` and a `thumbnail_ms`; seek with `?t=<start_ms / 1000>`) and `inactive_periods` (`start_ms`/`end_ms` stretches the replay player marked inactive, usually the gaps between chapters). Skip any chapter with `kind: idle`, which only older summaries carry.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the expected output structure of the summarizer observation and the handling of idle chapters, potentially aiding developers or users reading this documentation.
